summary: Iter13 security-fix regression: SEC-001 admin password rotation, SEC-002 ReDoS protection, brute-force lockout (5=>429), 7-day httpOnly JWT cookie with no token in body, password min-length 8, admin delete-user + self-delete block, and logout cookie clear. Backend pytest 17/17 passed. Frontend login/dashboard/logout flows verified via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes._check_lockout raises 429 only if a locked_until exists; the code correctly handles this, but consider clearing the lockout after LOCKOUT_MINUTES automatically (currently the record persists forever; fine because count check + expiry check both required).
TokenResponse still exposes access_token as Optional[str] in the model schema. Since the API never returns it, consider removing the field entirely from the response model to avoid confusion.

_REDOS_RX heuristic only catches (X+)+/*/(X*)*; more advanced ReDoS (e.g. overlapping alternations like (a|a)+) is not caught, but coverage is reasonable for the config surface. Consider a hard regex evaluation timeout as defense-in-depth.
